title: Builder Pattern
overview: Separate the construction of a complex object from its representation so the same process can create different representations.
useCases: Building an object is done in steps
Constructor is becoming unwieldy (too many parameters, variants, or tasks)
The same construction process should be able to produce different representations of the object
exampleUses: Constructing an HTTP request with optional headers, query parameters, body, and auth settings
Assembling a meal order (burger, sides, drink, extras) where each component is optional and chosen independently
Building a complex SQL query programmatically where clauses like WHERE, JOIN, and ORDER BY are added conditionally
